name: klicktipp
description: KlickTipp toolkit: read and write the product data of a KlickTipp account — contacts, tags, custom fields, opt-in processes, signatures and email newsletters — over the KlickTipp MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Work with the product data of a KlickTipp account — contacts, tags, fields and newsletters.
interface.longDescription: Connects to the KlickTipp MCP server (https://mcp.klicktipp.com/mcp, OAuth) and exposes the product API as tools: search and read contacts, subscribe/unsubscribe and enrich them, manage manual tags and custom field definitions, inspect opt-in processes and their redirect URLs, read signatures, and take an email newsletter from draft through content, audience, sender configuration and test send. Newsletter activation reaches real recipients and is a separate, explicitly approved tool call.
defaultPrompt: Find the contact test@example.com and show me its tags and fields.
Create a manual tag "Webinar 2026" and describe what it is for.
Draft a newsletter for everyone tagged "Webinar 2026" and send me a test.
